events.verdict: White (BOS) moves laterally into George (PHI), who stops short and does not dislodge him from his defensive position. The contact initiated by White is marginal.
Brown (BOS) clamps and pulls Embiid's (PHI) left arm, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Horford (BOS) makes clean contact with the ball as he swipes down and cleanly dislodges it away from Embiid (PHI).
Horford (BOS) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Maxey (PHI) releases the shot attempt prior to the expiration of the shot clock.
Martin (PHI) adjusts alongside Tatum's (BOS) path and is absorbing the body contact that occurs as they come together during the drive.
White (BOS) continues moving into Maxey (PHI) during the rebound and delivers contact that dislodges him from his position.
Horford (BOS) grazes Embiid's (PHI) face as he reaches in, but the contact is marginal.
Embiid (PHI) briefly rests a hand on Tatum's (BOS) body before quickly removing it during the shot attempt at the basket.
Brown (BOS) moves laterally into Maxey (PHI), who releases away from the contact. Brown is off-balance and his momentum carries him forwards.
White (BOS) repeatedly places a hand to Maxey's (PHI) chest, but the contact quickly dissolves.
Horford (BOS) maintains a forearm against Lowry's (PHI) body before making clean contact with the ball.
White (BOS) commits a take foul on George (PHI).
Martin (PHI) legally contests Brown's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Tatum (BOS) commits a take foul on Embiid (PHI).
White (BOS) steps out of bounds while in possession of the ball.
